text:
deploy-bot: Deployment kickoff: release/2026-03-15 -> prod (canary 10%). Model-serving image: v1.13.0. Runbook: /runbooks/deploys/v2.3. Rolling out in waves now.
Maya: Copy — I'll run the post-deploy smoke suite against canary endpoints and post probe results.
Sam: Starting synthetic probes (http + streaming) against canary-1/2. Cmd: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' http://canary-1.internal/v1/health`
canary-bot: probe@canary-1: /v1/health -> 200 0.12s, /v1/generate -> 502 (3/5), errors: upstream reset. avg latency for generate attempts: 3.6s.
Kevin: Seeing a bump in 5xx on streaming connections in the last 2 mins on grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/streams/stream-errors (link) — canary only.
Maya: Re-ran targeted streaming smoke: first attempt succeeded, next 2 attempts got `ERR_CONNECTION_RESET` while handshake. Pasted logs to thread.
Sam: Snapshot of curl traces:
```
> GET /v1/generate
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< Connection: close
error: upstream connection reset by peer
```
Looks like kernel-level resets on the runtime-side.
Maya: Given the failure mode and customer impact risk, I recommend halting rollout and rolling back canary to v1.12.2 (previous). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sam: +1. Pinning suggestion: keep hosted prod pinned to v1.12.2 until ENG-1893 root cause triaged. I'll prepare rollback.
Maya: I'll notify CS & oncall channels and pause scheduled change window for any further waves.
Sam: /deploy rollback --target=prod --from=release/2026-03-15 --to=release/2026-03-14   <-- kicking it now.
deploy-bot: Action: rollback started for canary group. Promoting release/2026-03-14 to canary. Rollout halted. Change window marked: emergency rollback.
canary-bot: post-rollback probes: /v1/health -> 200 0.11s, /v1/generate -> 200 (5/5), streaming handshake stable. avg latency 0.14s.
Maya: Confirming metrics look normal again; 5xx rate back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: Good call. Filing ENG-1893 with logs + kernel traces + release artifacts. Please add a synthetic streaming probe to the standard smoke suite (edge-case: TLS handshake resilience).
Sam: Added task to ENG-1893 and updated the release notes: "2026-03-15 release aborted: rollback to 2026-03-14 due to streaming connection resets observed in canary. Investigating runtime networking/kernel resets."
Maya: Follow-up: schedule a 30-min change window next Tue to reattempt with additional probes enabled. I'll post the invite after we have a mitigation plan.
Kevin: Thanks everyone. We'll loop in infra and runtime for RCA. Closing this thread once ENG-1893 is triaged. :lock:
